sloka: वसिष्ठ वाक्यम् तत् श्रुत्वा सुमंत्रः त्वरितः तदा ।व्यादिशत् पुरुषान् तत्र राज्ञाम् आनयने शुभान् ॥१-१३-३०॥
transliteration: vasiṣṭha vākyam tat śrutvā sumaṁtraḥ tvaritaḥ tadā ।vyādiśat puruṣān tatra rājñām ānayane śubhān ॥1-13-30॥

translations.english: Then, well pleased, the best among brahmins (Vasishta) said to them all "Nobody should be offered any thing with disregard. Anything given with contempt undoubtedly results in the destruction of the donor."
